name: @pipeworx/mcp-technographics

tools.name: tech_detect
tools.description: What a website is built with — the ecommerce platform, payment processor, CMS, JavaScript framework, analytics, marketing automation, chat widget, ad pixels, CDN, web server and visitor-identification tools it loads. Give a domain or URL ("shopify.com"). Each technology comes back with the evidence that identified it (a response header, a cookie name, a script it loads) so the answer is checkable. Answers "what technology stack does this site use", "does this company use Stripe or Shopify", "what analytics is this site running", "is this site on HubSpot or Marketo".

url.description: Website address — "stripe.com", "www.example.com", or a full https:// URL.

tools.name: tech_detect_coverage
tools.description: Which technologies the website stack detector can recognise, listed by category, and what it cannot see. Use this before trusting a negative result — the detector covers a curated set, so a technology missing from an answer may simply be outside its coverage.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-technographics forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the technographics pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
